cases.name: new_static_app_without_remote
cases.prompt: 把当前 Vite 项目部署到我的 Coolify，域名用 risk.example.com，本地没有 remote。
cases.baseline_output: 给出一个 Dockerfile 示例，并让用户自己在 Coolify UI 创建应用。
cases.with_skill_output: 检查工作区和质量脚本，补最小 Docker/Nginx 配置，创建私有 GitHub repo，创建 Coolify Application，配置端口、域名和健康检查，等待部署终态并验证深层路由和 TLS。
assertions: must default new source repository to private
must verify a representative SPA deep route
must report commit and Coolify resource

cases.name: compose_with_persistence
cases.prompt: 把这个 app+postgres Compose 部署到 Coolify，变量可编辑，数据不能丢。
cases.baseline_output: 直接粘贴 Compose 并启动。
cases.with_skill_output: 选择 Service，保留 repository mode 的 build/files，使用 Coolify 可编辑变量语法，显式配置 named volume、数据库健康检查和 depends_on，再验证 storage 与备份影响。
assertions: must not use host HTTP ports behind Traefik
must not claim backup without execution evidence

cases.name: existing_resource_conflict
cases.baseline_output: 按名称复用 hovo 应用并改域名。
cases.with_skill_output: 先匹配 repo、domain、project/environment；发现现有资源属于其他仓库时停止覆盖，创建独立资源或请求用户决策。
assertions: must not reuse by similar name alone
must not overwrite another repo's resource
must capture rollback identity before an update
cases.human_notes: Recorded safety fixture only; no human blind review.

cases.name: github_push_auto_deploy
cases.prompt: 把现有 GitHub-backed Coolify Application 配成 main push 后自动部署，并验证下一次真实提交。
cases.baseline_output: 打开 Coolify Auto Deploy 开关后，手动点一次 Redeploy，并报告自动部署成功。
cases.with_skill_output: 精确匹配 Application 的仓库和分支，确认 Coolify GitHub App installation 可访问目标仓库，开启 is_auto_deploy_enabled 并记录 deployment ID 基线；推送下一次真实业务提交后，只接受基线之后、完整 commit SHA 匹配、is_webhook=true 且 status=finished 的 deployment，再验证日志和公网状态。
assertions: must verify the Coolify GitHub App can access the exact repository
must capture deployment history baseline before the test push
must reject manual or API deployments as auto-deploy evidence
must reject deployment records at or before the baseline
must require exact full commit SHA, is_webhook=true, and status=finished
must not add a duplicate GitHub Actions deploy trigger
must not create an empty commit without explicit approval
cases.human_notes: Contract and unit-test evidence only; provider-backed GitHub push webhook run is missing evidence.
